rows.english: Evil is a rejection of life. Thus I am a guardian against evil.
rows.turkish: Kötülük, yaşamın reddedilmesidir. Bu yüzden kötülüğe karşı olan bir koruyucuyum.

rows.english: This territory must be ours.
They outnumber us!
I sense the presence of an ancient evil.
I am impervious to damage!
Hello, little friend. We're here to help.
rows.turkish: Merhaba küçük dostum. Yardım etmeye geldik.

rows.english: Let me help.
Rocket's Beacon has ceased its signal.
I feel bad for you…
Yes. It is the same with me and life energy.
rows.turkish: Evet. Ben ve yaşam enerjisi için de aynısı geçerli.

rows.english: They can't defeat the wind and thunder!
Beware! An enemy!
Watch out for Punisher's turret!
This area makes me nervous.
You don't have to fight alone.
We're closer, but we must hurry!
Souls, unite!
So much for Rocket's Amplifier!
Feeling bad?
Glad to help--Wait-- what?
rows.turkish: Yardım etmekten memnun oldum. Bekle… Ne dedin?

rows.english: Moon Knight left an ankh!
rows.turkish: Moon Knight bir yaşam çarmıhı bıraktı!

rows.english: You enjoyed that, Wolverine.
Friends, gather around!
You're so kind.
Without the sun, it's a miracle there's any life left here at all…
rows.turkish: Güneş olmadan burada yaşam belirtisi görmek bir mucize…

rows.english: I will finish your legend for you, Fox…
rows.turkish: Senin efsaneni senin için bitireceğim, Tilki…

rows.english: Did you see? Hawkeye missed!
Oh hi!
We must traverse the entire Hall of Djalia!
rows.turkish: Tüm Djalia Salonu'nu baştan sona geçmeliyiz!

rows.english: This place is humming with energy.
It feels so wrong!
Too many enemies!
So many terrible memories… it's overwhelming!
rows.turkish: Ne çok korkunç anı… insanın üstüne çöküyor!

rows.english: Poor Rocket. I never wanted to fight him.
rows.turkish: Zavallı Rocket. Onunla dövüşmeyi asla istemedim.

rows.english: You have saved me!
Even on the screen, he radiates a terrible evil.
rows.turkish: Ekranda bile korkunç bir kötülük yayıyor.

rows.english: Feel better, fight better!
rows.turkish: Daha iyi hisset, daha iyi savaş!

rows.english: I sense your concern. But you have already proven your worth. If this battle is to be won, it will be because you were on our side.
rows.turkish: Endişeni anlıyorum ama sen zaten değerini kanıtladın. Bu savaş kazanılacaksa sen bizim tarafımızda olduğunuz için olacaktır.

rows.english: Friends, gather around!
We still have a dangerous path to travel.
rows.turkish: Gitmemiz gereken tehlikeli bir yolumuz daha var.

rows.english: Chin up.
The Culling Turret is gone.
That's not polite!
What lovely beasts. A shame they fight against us.
rows.turkish: Ne sevimli yaratıklar. Bize karşı savaşmaları ne acı.

rows.english: A fistful of victories!
Arakko is being consumed by a techno-virus. Can you reverse it?
rows.turkish: Arakko bir tekno virüs tarafından tüketiliyor. Bu durumu tersine çevirebilir misin?

rows.english: The Beacon needs to heal itself.
Join me, friends.
Not much further until we are underground.
How terrible, to injure a tree.
rows.turkish: Bir ağaca zarar vermek ne kadar da korkunç.

rows.english: A portal! Be ready to fight!
Here we are again. Back where our journey together began.
rows.turkish: İşte yine buradayız. Birlikte yolculuğumuzun başladığı yere geri döndük.

rows.english: Ooh, that's a long fall.
Peter! That felt wrong.
We will get you back home… if your timeline still exists…
rows.turkish: Sizi tekrar eve götüreceğiz… Zaman tüneliniz yerinde duruyorsa tabii…

rows.english: Ankh here! Step carefully.
rows.turkish: Burada yaşam çarmıhı var! Adımlarınıza dikkat edin.

rows.english: Quill, why did you crash the Milano here, of all places?
rows.turkish: Quill, o kadar yer varken Milano'yu neden buraya düşürdün?

rows.english: We can not stop until the Kingpin's plans are undone!
rows.turkish: Kingpin'in planları boşa çıkarılana kadar duramayız!

rows.english: The Guardians of the Galaxy are misfits who make me feel at home.
rows.turkish: Galaksinin Koruyucuları denen uyumsuzlar beni evimde hissettiriyor.

rows.english: We are undefeatable!
I don't think you despise Banner quite as much as you want everyone to think.
rows.turkish: Bence Banner'dan herkesin düşünmesini istediğin kadar nefret etmiyorsun.

rows.english: The spiders are after me!
Mantis has returned!
I'm wounded, please help me!
Triple success!
Hurry! I cannot be put back in the Collector's menagerie!
rows.turkish: Acele et! Koleksiyoncu'nun koleksiyonuna geri konulamam!

rows.english: Destroyed the Amplifier!
Dracula is near. I can feel his presence.
Adam Warlock's light has dimmed.
I am healed!
To protect the sanctity of life. Isn't that what you were built to do?
rows.turkish: Yaşamın kutsallığını korumak için. Geliştirilme amacın bu değil mi?

rows.english: Help, friends.
I can help you find some rest. If you allow it.
rows.turkish: Eğer izin verirsen, biraz dinlenmene yardım edebilirim.

rows.english: Doctor Strange opened a portal!
Help, please!
Groot? Please, can you come back?
Right there…
We must cleanse this living planet of Ultron's influence.
rows.turkish: Bu yaşayan gezegeni Ultron'un etkisinden arındırmalıyız.

rows.english: I am less angry now.
One must not give in to hate, but one can still enjoy revenge.
rows.turkish: Kişi nefrete boyun eğmemeli ama yine de intikâmın keyfini çıkarmalı.

rows.english: I labeled it "not blood," to avoid confusion.
rows.turkish: Karışmasın diye üstüne “kan değil” diye etiketledim.

rows.english: Our enemies are here!
The people of K'un-Lun… Their souls are so focused…
rows.turkish: K'un-Lun halkı… Ruhları o kadar odaklanmış ki…

rows.english: Punisher is out of his turret again!
Thor… what happens when the gods die?
Uh oh. Punisher's in turret mode!
I also sense great sarcasm.
Down!
There are still innocents trapped here, Sai. They deserve their freedom as well.
rows.turkish: Burada hâlâ mahsur kalmış masumlar var, Sai. Onlar da özgürlüklerini hak ediyor.

rows.english: That you need a bigger gun?
rows.turkish: Daha büyük bir silaha mı ihtiyacın var?

rows.english: Loki, why do you lie?
Heroes are suffering. We shall set them free!
rows.turkish: KAHRAMANLAR acı çekiyor. Onları özgür bırakacağız!

rows.english: I can manage. Then we'll free everyone from the Collector's Themepark, yes?
rows.turkish: İdare edebilirim. Herkesi Koleksiyoncu'nun Tema Parkı'ndan daha sonra kurtarırız, olur mu?

rows.english: Martial art sharpens your mind.
Much of this could be destroyed.
Rest easy, ancient one. We will avenge you.
rows.turkish: Huzur içinde uyu, kadim olan. Seni intikamla onurlandıracağız.

rows.english: Don't hold in your emotions, let them out.
rows.turkish: Duygularını içinizde tutma, serbest bırak onları.

rows.english: And yet there is so much more to you. Sides that no one ever gets to see. But I see you, Loki… and I smile…
rows.turkish: Ve yine de sende çok daha fazlası var. Kimsenin asla göremediği yanların. Ama ben seni görüyorum, LOKI… ve gülümsüyorum…

rows.english: Faster! This island is being consumed by Ultron!
rows.turkish: Daha hızlı! Bu ada Ultron tarafından tüketiliyor!

rows.english: Such darkness. The sooner we deliver this, the better.
rows.turkish: Ne kadar karanlık. Bunu ne kadar erken teslim edersek o kadar iyi.

rows.english: It pleases me to be helpful.
Your light daggers are strong, sister.
I feel vulnerable!
The spider nest is nonfunctional.
The Thunder is gone.
I am purified!
Easily. All that power is nice. But being alive? That's the true adventure.
rows.turkish: Kolayca. Tüm o güç güzel. Ama hayatta olmak mı? İşte gerçek macera bu.

rows.english: I feel your pain…
A Guardian… never gives up!
I see a portal!
We are on our way to victory!
Yggdrasil needs us! Asgard needs us!
I am not ready to move on. Not yet.
rows.turkish: Devam etmeye hazır değilim. Henüz değil.

rows.english: People often mistake empathy for weakness.
You should not have stepped there.
Friends, we need to fall back!
Such gentle creatures, forced into war…
rows.turkish: Savaşa zorlanmışlar… Aslında ne kadar nazik yaratıklar…

rows.english: Okay, understood!
Ohh, I need assistance!
On we go, to the tower of Avengers!
Jeff! No! You were the best of us…
I'm ready to heal!
Your claws are as fierce as your heart, Cat.
Really? How fascinating…
There! Hunt the enemy sniper!
rows.turkish: İşte orada! Düşmanın keskin nişancısını yere ser!

rows.english: Makes me feel good.
Sometimes you can reason with people and sometimes they need a kick in the teeth.
rows.turkish: Bazen insanlarla mantıklı bir şekilde konuşabilirsin, bazen de suratlarına tekme indirmen gerekir.

rows.english: I can feel our fellow heroes' despair from here…
We triumph together!
Team, they are taking over the area, be swift!
rows.turkish: Takım, bölgeyi ele geçiriyorlar. Çabuk olun!

rows.english: The Guardians of the Galaxy value ALL life.
rows.turkish: Galaksinin Koruyucuları HERKESİN yaşamına değer verir.

rows.english: I… should really be going now…
No. The Collector was my captor. But I can sense that we both suffered great trauma.
rows.turkish: Hayır. Beni esir alan Koleksiyoncu’ydu. Ama ikimizin de büyük bir travma yaşadığını hissedebiliyorum.

rows.english: This vehicle must be halted!
Protect The Book of the Iron Fist at all costs!
rows.turkish: Iron Fist Kitabı’nı ne pahasına olursa olsun koruyun!

rows.english: I am kidding! Sometimes it is fun to wind you up, Rocket.
rows.turkish: Şaka yapıyorum! Bazen seni kızdırmak eğlenceli oluyor Rocket.

rows.english: This place was once so green and vital. All that's left is darkness and decay.
rows.turkish: Burası bir zamanlar yemyeşil ve hayat doluydu. Şimdi geriye kalan tek şey ise karanlık ve çürüme.

rows.english: You and I share much in common. I too was held against my will?
rows.turkish: Seninle benim birçok ortak yanımız var. Ben de kendi irademe karşı tutulmuştum?

rows.english: I was a prisoner of the Collector. One day I will get even.
rows.turkish: Koleksiyoncu'nun tutsağıydım ama bir gün onunla ödeşeceğiz.

rows.english: Life energy brings me back!
Ultron, you sicken me.
These are the final moments! Strike harder!
rows.turkish: Bunlar son anları! Daha şiddetli saldırın!

rows.english: I think not.
Hostile ahead!
Knull's darkness cannot be unleashed!
Rocket, that hurt me, too.
rows.turkish: Rocket, bu benim de canımı yaktı.

rows.english: Namor abused their loyalty. He must pay.
rows.turkish: Namor onların sadakatini kötüye kullandı. Bedelini ödemeli.

rows.english: My leader! Star-Lord!
End this vehicle's journey.
Maybe I made myself too powerful.
rows.turkish: Belki de kendimi gereğinden fazla güçlendirdim.

rows.english: Shake it up.
I am bursting with life energy!
What? I can't be healed!
I must regroup with the rest of the Guardians, the Collector MUST be stopped!
rows.turkish: Diğer Muhafızlarla tekrar bir araya gelmeliyim, Koleksiyoncu MUTLAKA durdurulmalı!

rows.english: He says it was you.
Can I help?
Beacon's broken!
Life always wins!
Hmmm, new perspective.
We should group up!
I happen to be good friends with a rodent…
Mantis, ready for combat.
I found the sniper first.
I am wounded! Who will help?
I got the sniper!
We may have to ally with one Doom — temporarily — to defeat the other.
rows.turkish: Diğerini yenmek için Doomlardan biriyle geçici ittifak kurmamız gerekebilir.

rows.english: Spider-Zero, you will reach the Budokan. That is my promise.
I can feel Arakko's pain. We must act now!
rows.turkish: Arakko'nun acısını hissedebiliyorum. Hemen harekete geçmeliyiz!

rows.english: I spotted an enemy here.
I can feel the power of nature.
We stand together, Quill. The way it should be.
rows.turkish: Birlikte dimdik duruyoruz, Quill. Olması gerektiği gibi.

rows.english: I can feel that you really mean it, Loki. I must admit, you are not who I expected you to be.
rows.turkish: Bunu gerçekten içten söylediğini hissedebiliyorum, LOKI. İtiraf etmeliyim, sen beklediğim kişi değilsin.

rows.english: Cosmic bond!
Mantis is ready to strike!
A person's physical form does not matter nearly as much as the spirit within.
rows.turkish: Birinin fiziksel formu, içindeki ruh kadar neredeyse hiç önemli değildir.

rows.english: Oh, uhh, they are… the cutest animal on Earth!
rows.turkish: Vay canına, onlar… Dünyadaki en tatlı hayvanlar!

rows.english: You made…me…angry!
We must reach the Weaver to save the Web!
I sense great sadness in you.
You look tired.
I'm getting old waiting for us to attack.
Escort this vehicle to its destination.
rows.turkish: Bu araca varış noktasına kadar eşlik edin.

rows.english: Too fast for you.
We must press the attack!
Soul Resurgence is almost ready!
NOW I'm confident.
Healing? Too kind!
rows.turkish: İyileştirildim mi az önce? Çok naziksin!

rows.english: Attack and capture this place!
Protect the Statue of Bast at all costs!
rows.turkish: Bast heykelini ne pahasına olursa olsun koruyun!

rows.english: Hulk… your anger is so very loud! I feel the world would be a safer place, if you managed to calm it.
rows.turkish: Hulk… Öfken çok ama çok gürültülü! Onu sakinleştirmeyi başarabilseydin, dünyanın daha güvenli bir yer olacağını hissediyorum.

rows.english: I've escaped this place before. Follow my lead!
rows.turkish: Bu yerden daha önce kaçtım. Beni takip edin!

rows.english: Fascinating. I can detect strange emanations from you, but no real emotions or feelings.
rows.turkish: Büyüleyici. Senden gelen tuhaf yayılımlar tespit edebiliyorum ama gerçek bir duygu ya da his yok.

rows.english: I am truly restored!
May we meet again, Loki…
My anger is healthy.
This city shines like a golden beacon… but it's hiding a dark secret…
rows.turkish: Bu şehir altın bir işaret gibi parlıyor… ama karanlık bir sırrı saklıyor…

rows.english: I will take risks!
I live to fight another day!
rows.turkish: Başka bir gün savaşmak için yaşıyorum!

rows.english: Oh no, look behind you!
I don't like fire.
I wouldn’t mess with Groot, that's for sure.
My life was ebbing…thank you.
A fire burns inside you.
Are you anxious?
Take a nap.
We must cast this monstrosity out from our world.
A nest of tiny spider bombs!
rows.turkish: Minik örümcek bombalarından oluşan bir yuva!

rows.english: Such an emotional time, I like it!
rows.turkish: Ne duygusal bir an! Çok hoşuma gitti.

rows.english: We are undefeatable!
Rocket, you always deliver!
rows.turkish: Rocket, her zaman bir şeyler yapıyorsun!

rows.english: I broke the ankh!
They will attack until we defeat them once and for all.
rows.turkish: Biz onların kökünü kazıyana kadar saldıracaklar.

rows.english: Yes!
The ankh is gone!
I vented my anger.
Five alive!
The Web needs the Weaver, and the Weaver needs you, Spider-Zero.
rows.turkish: Ağ'ın Dokumacı'ya, Dokumacı'nın da sana ihtiyacı var Spider-Zero.

rows.english: This web…what powerful energy emanates from it.
rows.turkish: Bu ağdan ne kadar güçlü bir enerji yayılıyor böyle!

rows.english: Saving the timeline from total collapse. Care to join me?
rows.turkish: Zaman tünelini çökmeden önce kurtarmaya gidiyorum. Bana katılmak ister misin?

rows.english: Gladly. -gasp- There is something else in you, something… unnatural!
rows.turkish: Memnuniyetle. -nefes nefese- Sende doğal olmayan başka bir şeyler var!

rows.english: That's a lie. I sense that you DO care for your subjects.
rows.turkish: Bu bir yalan. Halkına önem VERDİĞİNİ hissediyorum.

rows.english: Sniper! We'll be picked off!
The Entanglement turns Guardian against Guardian.
Any timeline is better off without Ultron.
rows.turkish: Ultron’un olmadığı her zaman tüneli daha iyidir.

rows.english: Do not back down! Our allies are counting on us to set them free!
rows.turkish: Geri çekilmeyin! Müttefiklerimiz onları özgür bırakmamız için bize güveniyor!

rows.english: Nothing heals the soul like a bit of gardening…
rows.turkish: Ruhu biraz bahçıvanlık kadar iyileştiren bir şey yok…

rows.english: Peter Quill says it's your fault the Milano crashed here.
rows.turkish: Peter Quill dedi ki Milano'nun buraya çakılması senin suçunmuş.

rows.english: We fight for the survival of worlds — not for personal glory.
rows.turkish: Kişisel zaferler için değil, dünyaların hayatta kalması için savaşıyoruz.

rows.english: I feel a little weak.
Take your lies elsewhere.
Knull's dark soul can be used against him.
rows.turkish: Knull'un karanlık ruhunu ona karşı kullanabiliriz.

rows.english: Ah, thank you.
This is natural anger!
Oh, no! Rocket is down!
The arena… it's hungry.
If the timelines are merged again, I wonder which version of me will survive.
rows.turkish: Zaman tünelleri yeniden bir araya gelirse hangi versiyonumun hayatta kalacağını merak ediyorum.

rows.english: Did I hurt your feelings?
Oh, these ancient powers…they speak to me.
rows.turkish: Ah, bu kadim güçler benimle konuşuyor.

rows.english: And if that cycle is broken by powers far greater than we can comprehend?
rows.turkish: Ya o döngü, kavrayamayacağımız kadar büyük güçler tarafından kırılırsa?

rows.english: I don't have to read your mind to know what you're thinking.
rows.turkish: Ne düşündüğünü bilmek için aklını okumama gerek yok.

rows.english: Doom must be a broken man, to be so careless with so many lives.
rows.turkish: Bu kadar çok kişinin hayatını tehlikeye attığına göre Doom zamanında çok aşağılanmış olmalı.

rows.english: Life energy rises!
Down you go.
Rocket's Amplifier is powered down.
Let us save the great tree!
Peter Quill, unstoppable force!
So many people imprisoned. And ready to be free.
rows.turkish: Ne çok insan tutsak edilmiş. Ve özgür kalmaya hazırlar.

rows.english: Am I truly invincible?
You focused on all the wrong things, Cyclops.
My spirit still lingers on this plane…
Bodies falter, but the soul fights on!
rows.turkish: Bedenler tökezler, ama ruh savaşmayı sürdürür!

rows.english: I feel the tree's pain! We must hurry!
Focus on the battle!
Good things come to those who wait.
I sense great worry in you, Peter. What troubles you so?
rows.turkish: Çok endişeli olduğunu hissediyorum Peter. Nedir seni bu kadar rahatsız eden?

rows.english: What if I am harmed?
You seem very anxious about your role as protector of this Web.
rows.turkish: Ağ'ın koruyucusu olma rolü seni çok germiş sanki.

rows.english: Three times as proud!
The path to the Budokan is dangerous. We will protect you.
rows.turkish: Budokan'a giden yol tehlikelidir. Seni koruyacağız.

rows.english: Do not deviate from your programming, H.E.R.B.I.E.
We are one!
I must resist…
A legend shall never fall.
Rest easy now, my gelatinous friends.
Pausing in your war against all life, Ultron?
rows.turkish: Tüm yaşama karşı savaşına ara mı veriyorsun Ultron?

rows.english: Jubilee! I brought you a pre-battle snack to build your energy! I hope vampires enjoy… juice boxes?
rows.turkish: JUBILEE! Savaş öncesi enerjini toplaman için sana bir atıştırmalık getirdim! Vampirler… meyve suyu kutularını sever mi acaba?

rows.english: Come with us, strange creature…
Destroy the ankh!
I apologize. Your soul burns so bright. Almost more intense than your flames.
rows.turkish: Özür dilerim. Ruhun öyle bir yanıyor ki neredeyse alevlerinden daha yoğun.

rows.english: Ease down.
I can feel Knull stirring within this world. We can't let him reclaim his throne.
rows.turkish: Knull'un bu dünyada kıpırdadığını hissedebiliyorum. Onun tahtını geri almasına izin veremeyiz.

rows.english: Keep fighting! You do NOT want to end up in the Collector's clutches!
rows.turkish: Savaşmaya devam et! Koleksiyoncu'nun pençesine düşmek istemezsin!

rows.english: T'Challa awaits us.
You came all this way to save your fellow Asgardians. You are a hero after all!
rows.turkish: Buraya kadar diğer Asgardlıları kurtarmak için geldin. Sonuçta sen bir kahramansın!

rows.english: Stay together, around the book!
Never fear, we will soon reach the Weaver!
Hulk, is there something on your mind? Can I help?
rows.turkish: Hulk, aklında bir şey mi var? Yardım edebilir miyim?

rows.english: The king of the vampires awaits…
So much we could destroy here!
rows.turkish: Burada yok edecek çok fazla şey var!

rows.english: The island itself lives and breathes like we do. We have to protect it at all costs.
rows.turkish: Adanın kendisi de bizim gibi yaşıyor ve nefes alıyor. Her ne pahasına olursa olsun onu korumalıyız.

rows.english: My wounds need healing!
Who needs healing?
This is natural anger!
The Collector's cosmic cruelty ends today!
A fine place for an attack!
Reality is ending… yet you remain calm and serene. How?
rows.turkish: Gerçeklik sona eriyor… Yine de sakin ve dingin kalmayı başarıyorsun. Nasıl?

rows.english: I cannot move.
We do not have the numbers to match them.
Hi, there!
Oh, my… Am I the only one who can hear Arakko screaming?
rows.turkish: Amanın… Arakko'nun çığlıklarını bir tek ben mi duyuyorum?

rows.english: They want what we want, team!
rows.turkish: Onlar da bizim istediğimizi istiyor takım!

rows.english: Life energy is a powerful weapon against evil.
rows.turkish: Yaşam enerjisi, kötülüğe karşı güçlü bir silah.

rows.english: Feel the heal!
I will remain loyal to my friends.
If only we all could find such peace in the face of potential annihilation.
rows.turkish: Keşke hepimiz potansiyel yok oluşun karşısında böyle bir huzuru bulabilseydik.

rows.english: Good job, Bi Xi! Steady on!
rows.turkish: İyi iş, Bi Xi! Dayan, böyle!

rows.english: I built myself a new body. Like it?
Well… You ARE stretched thin lately.
rows.turkish: Şey… Son zamanlarda ÇOK yoruyorsun kendini

rows.english: Our duty is now to protect this place!
Sometimes empathy is a heavy burden to bear.
rows.turkish: Empati bazen taşıması ağır bir yüktür.

rows.english: Mantis strikes!
You needed some help, didn't you?
How do you contain such vast energy as the weather?
rows.turkish: Hava gibi böylesine engin bir enerjiyi nasıl içinde tutuyorsun?

rows.english: I have removed the spider threat.
Is it? I just meant the feeling I could sense.
rows.turkish: Öyle mi? Sadece hissedebildiğim o duyguyu kastetmiştim.

rows.english: Do you have to burn everything?
Chin up.
This core is Arakko's only hope.
Mantis and Rocket make a great team!
rows.turkish: Mantis ve Rocket'tan harika bir takım olur!

rows.english: Peter Quill!
Our goal will not be achieved without a fight.
We must hold out a little longer.
Loki. This is…  not the version of you I was expecting…
Don't come back.
I have escaped this horrid place before. I have no doubt I will do so again.
rows.turkish: Bu korkunç yerden daha önce kaçtım. Tekrar yapacağımdan hiç şüphem yok.

rows.english: I feel strong!
You got too close to the edge.
I am glad I was able to return here and help lead him to freedom.
rows.turkish: Buraya geri dönebilmiş ve onu özgürlüğe giden yola yönlendirmeye yardım edebilmiş olmama sevindim.

rows.english: Would you feel better if I told you that all super heroes feel the same way?
rows.turkish: Sana tüm süper kahramanların böyle hissettiğini söylesem kendini daha iyi hisseder miydin?

rows.english: I defeated them all by myself!
Revenge is mentally unhealthy…but very satisfying.
rows.turkish: İntikâm zihinsel olarak sağlıksızdır ama çok keyif verir.

rows.english: Your arrow cuts through the air.
My anger is purged. Ahhhhh.
We need not fear the ankh anymore!
rows.turkish: Yaşam çarmıhından korkmamıza gerek yok artık!

rows.english: We'll win. I can feel it!
Mantis is now available.
I am happy to see you too. And happy we will be in this battle together!
rows.turkish: Ben de seni gördüğüme ve bu savaşta bu savaşta birlikte olacağımıza sevindim!

rows.english: Ha! You're so sensitive.
T'Challa needs this sacred totem at once.
rows.turkish: T'Challa'nın bu kutsal toteme acilen ihtiyacı var.

rows.english: Flower power!
Mantis strikes!
Getting my kicks!
What? No.
Five in a row!
Spiritual energy accumulation in progress.
This area must be defended!
Defend this place no matter what!
These creatures obey Namor's every command.
rows.turkish: Bu yaratıklar Namor'un her bir emrine uyuyor.

rows.english: I can be reckless!
Now I am more dangerous!
I can hardly feel nature…
What a horrible, corrupted life this place must breed.
rows.turkish: Burası ne kadar korkunç ve yozlaşmış.

rows.english: They are coming from behind!
I'll be ready. But for today, we fight a common enemy.
rows.turkish: Hazır olacağım fakat bugün ortak bir düşmana karşı savaşıyoruz.

rows.english: Beware, enemies!
There were enemies here.
I will not be harmed.
You are cute AND badass.
rows.turkish: Sen tatlısın VE sert bir çocuksun.

rows.english: One may feel empathy for an enemy, and still destroy them.
rows.turkish: İnsan bir düşmanla empati kurabilir ama onu yine de yok edebilir.

rows.english: We can help you achieve your directive, H.E.R.B.I.E.
We must cut off Loki's supply of chronovium!
It's life energy. It takes time to grow.
rows.turkish: Bu yaşam enerjisi. Büyümesi zaman alır.

rows.english: Concentrate attacks in this area.
The bond we share can't be broken, Adam.
I forced the Punisher out of his turret!
I feel your joy, Devil… and I share it!
rows.turkish: Neşeni hissediyorum, Şeytan… ve ben de paylaşıyorum!

rows.english: My little friend, cast in bronze!
I have transcended the physical realm.
I need some help!
Spiders from this nest are hunting us!
rows.turkish: Bu yuvadan gelen örümcekler hep peşimizde!

rows.english: My life energy flows stronger!
I have to admit, Loki, I may have misjudged you.
rows.turkish: İtiraf etmeliyim, LOKI, seni yanlış değerlendirmiş olabilirim.

rows.english: I thought you should know there're Asgardians imprisoned in the Collector's Themepark, King of Lies.
rows.turkish: Koleksiyoncu'nun Tema Parkı'nda hapsedilmiş Asgardlılar var Yalanlar Kralı.

rows.english: Listen to my soul sonata!
Ease down.
Help is here.
gasp- Goddess of nature!
Ultron was a hateful being.
We must retreat for safety!
Soon they will fail, if we stay strong!
Here is the vehicle we must protect.
Sensational!
I smashed all the spiders!
Hey, team, step it up a little!
We could defend well here.
Martial art sharpens your mind.
My strength is gone!
A sniper has spotted us!
That was a long time ago. Now, I am just Mantis.
rows.turkish: Bu çok uzun zaman önceydi. Şimdi, sadece Mantis'im.

rows.english: Feel lucky that you are only here as a guest… and not as an exhibit…
rows.turkish: Kendini şanslı hisset; burada sadece bir misafir olarak bulunuyorsun… bir sergi parçası olarak değil…

rows.english: Backslaps and bearhugs!
Groot, you know just what to say.
Thrice as nice!
Life energy is my eternal guide, and the source of my powers.
rows.turkish: Yaşam enerjisi benim ebedi rehberim ve güçlerimin kaynağı.

rows.english: I have some scores to settle!
You can do this, Bi Xi! We all can!
rows.turkish: Bunu yapabilirsin, Bi Xi! Hepimiz yapabiliriz!

rows.english: I could learn so much in this place.
Heal, body and soul!
…but it is truly full of horrors. You can feel it too, can't you, Adam?
rows.turkish: …ama gerçekten dehşetlerle dolu. Sen de hissediyorsun, değil mi, Adam?

rows.english: Look! Here is an enemy.
The Weaver needs Spider-Zero's help! Onward!
rows.turkish: Dokumacı'nın Spider-Zero'ya ihtiyacı var! Harekete geçiyoruz.

rows.english: Poor creatures. They served a cruel king…
rows.turkish: Zavallı yaratıklar. Acımasız bir krala hizmet ettiler…

rows.english: The sniper is no longer a threat.
rows.turkish: Keskin nişancı artık bir tehdit değil.

rows.english: Circle of life.
Punisher has enabled his turret!
Revenge is the most visceral of impulses.
